name: services/exams/batch_register_exam
description: Register multiple users at one request
brief_description: Register multiple users at one request

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: Dictionary of group's numbers to dictionaries mapping slot numbers to lists of user IDs.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
Dictionary of structure similar to values parameter. But instead of user IDs dictionaries mapping user IDs to one of following statuses are returned:
  • success
  • w_already_registered
  • e_already_registered
  • e_not_permitted
errors: • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist; param_name is equal to exam_id.
